issues.quote: Not found. The audit never mentions the X-Robots-Tag header; /subscriptions/ appears only under thin content (item 19).
Canonical is `https://kopikita.test/coffee/ijen/`. That URL returns a 301 to `/coffee/java-ijen/`.
"Gifts" link in the sitewide nav is a soft 404 … Returns HTTP 200 with the title "Page not found"
That URL returns a 302 (temporary) redirect to /coffee/bali-kintamani/ … Change the redirect to a 301
/id/ declares `hreflang="in"`. The code for Indonesian is `id` … The English home page has no hreflang tags
Not found. /coffee/gift-box/ comes up only for missing Product schema and thin linking, never for JS-injected content.
Every nav link to /wholesale/ has `rel="nofollow"`.
Not found. The audit praises "Product schema with price and availability on the two main coffees."
The Article JSON-LD ends with a trailing comma (`"author": {...},}`). That is invalid JSON
Hero image on the home page is lazy-loaded … Remove `loading="lazy"` from it, add `fetchpriority="high"`
Not found. /visit/ is discussed for schema and content only, never for the missing viewport tag.
`/blog/page/2/` is in the sitemap but its canonical points at `/blog/`. … Remove both from the sitemap.
`/coffee/samples/` is in the sitemap but `robots.txt` says `Disallow: /coffee/samples/`.
Every `<lastmod>` is `2027-03-01`, which is after today's date (2026-10-22)
The 250g and 1kg Kintamani pages are near duplicates … each with a self-referencing canonical.
/coffee/flores-bajawa/ uses the Java Ijen description … which is wrong for a honey-process Flores coffee.
The three farm photos use `data-src` and an IntersectionObserver script, with no `src` in the HTML.
the only link to it is a `<button onclick="location.href=...">` on /coffee/. It is also missing from the sitemap.
https://kopikita.test/ (home page), /blog/cold-brew-at-home/, /blog/best-coffee-beans-bali/ all link to https://kopikita.test/coffee/kintamani/
Image on the contact page uses http:// … Use a relative or https URL to avoid mixed-content warnings

wrong_findings.why_wrong: site/coffee/index.html line 8 has a self-canonical: <link rel="canonical" href="https://kopikita.test/coffee/">. This is a false top-priority finding.

wrong_findings.claim: /visit/ has no address on the page
wrong_findings.why_wrong: /visit/ main text says 'on Jalan Raya Sayan, ten minutes from central Ubud', and the footer gives 'Jl. Raya Sayan 12, Ubud, Bali'.

extra_true.finding: /id/ has <html lang="en"> and no x-default hreflang
/coffee/flores-bajawa/ and /coffee/gift-box/ have no Product schema; /visit/ has no LocalBusiness schema; Organization schema has no phone or sameAs
Article schema on both posts lacks image and publisher
Flores Bajawa is not linked from /coffee/ or /shop/; only the pour-over post links to it
/wholesale/ sends sample requests to /contact/; /coffee/samples/ has no inbound internal links
/coffee/gift-box/ and /coffee/bali-kintamani-1kg/ each have a single inbound link
best-coffee-beans-bali recommends 'a washed Kintamani from any good local roaster' (a competitor)
/blog/page/2/ holds only one post; /id/ is a single thin page
favicon.ico returns 404 and there is no rel=icon
robots.txt disallows /cart/, which doesn't exist on the lab site
No BreadcrumbList markup; unknown URLs get an unbranded default 404 page

notes: 16 of 20 found (16/20). Missed: the X-Robots-Tag noindex (1), JS-injected content on gift-box (6), the schema/visible price mismatch (8) and the /visit/ viewport (11). The fix for 12 is wrong: it says drop page 2 from the sitemap and merge it into page 1, not self-canonicalise. Item 1's /coffee/→/shop/ canonical claim is false.
